items.title: Coffee Unit Sale Could Be A Big Move For Kraft Heinz Stock (KHC)
items.summary: Kraft Heinz plans to sell its North American coffee business for US$650 million, retain a minority stake, and direct most proceeds toward debt reduction, while also reporting third quarter 2026 sales of US$6,115 million and net income of US$544 million. The planned coffee divestment simplifies Kraft Heinz’s portfolio and frees up cash for balance sheet repair at a time when the business is still absorbing goodwill and intangible asset impairments.
